name: Intervention-timing comprehension check (H4)
citation: AgentPause project (2026). Ad-hoc comprehension items; NOT validated.

items.text: When AgentPause postpones a question, what is the latest moment it will ask?
options: Before the first step that cannot be undone and depends on the answer
At the very end of the task
Whenever the agent finishes the current sub-task
items.correct: Before the first step that cannot be undone and depends on the answer

items.text: Why might AgentPause not ask a question as soon as the agent becomes unsure?
options: Interrupting mid-task costs more, and a better moment may come before anything irreversible happens
Questions are always asked at the start
items.correct: Interrupting mid-task costs more, and a better moment may come before anything irreversible happens

items.text: An action is easy to undo and the agent is confident. What would AgentPause most likely do?
Which kind of question does AgentPause NOT postpone?
options: Questions about your goals or constraints
Approval of an action that runs later
items.correct: Questions about your goals or constraints

notes: Example items. Adapt them to your explanation conditions and pre-register.
